label: Pagination
description: Data grid with pagination. Best for a starting point for client side paging over an in-memory list of users.

label: Cell Borders
description: Data grid with cell border. Best for vertical lines between columns as well as rows, with the table set in a Card and the pager below it.

label: Dense Layout
description: Data grid with dense layout. Best for shorter rows and tighter cell padding that fit more records into the same height.

label: Borderless
description: Data grid without table borders. Best for rows with no divider lines, rounded row ends and a coloured presence dot on each avatar.

label: Striped Rows
description: Data grid with striped rows. Best for alternating shaded rows with rounded ends that help the eye follow a record across columns.

label: Auto Width
description: Data grid with auto width. Best for a few columns that share the phone's width by their sizes, with no sideways scroll.

label: Row Selection
description: Data grid with row selection. Best for a checkbox per row plus a header checkbox that selects the current screen, held in controlled state.

label: Expandable Rows
description: Data grid with expandable rows. Best for a chevron that opens a short note under each row, drawn by the column's expandedContent and kept in view as the grid scrolls.

label: Sub Table
description: Data grid with sub table. Best for order rows that expand into a nested grid of line items, each with its own sorting and paging.

label: Column Icons
description: Data grid with column icons. Best for an icon beside each header title, with sorting switched off so every header is a plain label.

label: Sortable Columns
description: Data grid with sortable columns. Best for header buttons that step each column through ascending, descending and unsorted, with an arrow.

label: Movable Columns
description: Data grid with movable columns. Best for a header menu with sort entries plus Move to left and Move to right for reordering columns.

label: Draggable Columns
description: Data grid with draggable columns. Best for a grip on each header that drags its column to a new place, with move actions for screen readers.

label: Draggable Rows
description: Data grid with draggable rows. Best for a grip on each row that drags it to a new place (or move actions), with the order kept by the example.

label: Column Resizing
description: Data grid with column resizing. Best for handles on header ends dragged to set widths (stepped by screen readers), with Staff taking spare width and Status locked.

label: Pinnable Columns
description: Data grid with pinnable columns. Best for an 8 column grid that scrolls sideways under a Name column pinned at the start, pinnable from each header's menu.

label: Sticky Header
description: Data grid with sticky header. Best for a header that stays put while a page of 10 rows scrolls inside a fixed height.

label: Column Controls
description: Data grid with column controls. Best for header menus that combine sort, pin, move and a column visibility list, plus resize handles.

label: Card Container
description: Data grid with card container. Best for a Card with a Users title, an Add user action and the pager in its footer around the rows.

label: Column Visibility
description: Data grid with column visibility controls. Best for a Columns button in the card header that shows or hides each hideable column.

label: Loading Skeleton
description: Data grid with loading skeleton. Best for placeholder rows drawn from each column's skeleton, with an avatar and two text bars standing in for a person.

label: CRUD Admin
description: Data grid with CRUD features. Best for a member admin list with search, a status filter menu showing counts, row checkboxes and a row actions menu.

label: CRUD in Frame
description: Data grid with CRUD in a frame. Best for search, a status filter and row actions in a dense stacked Frame titled Team members.

label: Totals Footer
description: Data grid with column totals footer. Best for one footer row that sums every balance, with its label spanning the columns to the left.

label: Summary Stats Footer
description: Data grid with summary stats footer. Best for two footer rows of statistics: lowest and highest balance, then the average and an active member count.

label: Aggregate Footer
description: Data grid with per-column aggregate footer. Best for footer cells under Balance and Transactions that each show the average over a lowest to highest range.

label: Local Infinite Scroll
description: Data grid with local infinite scroll. Best for 200 in-memory rows drawn as they scroll into a 480 point window, with a sticky header and no pager.

label: Remote Infinite Scroll
description: Data grid with remote infinite scroll. Best for feeds that append the next server page as the reader reaches the end, and say when all are loaded.

label: Row Pinning
description: Data grid with row pinning. Best for rows pinned above the rest from a pin column, kept across pages with a count and Unpin all.

label: Tree Rows
description: Data grid with tree rows. Best for a department, team and member hierarchy with expand buttons, where each page counts departments only.

label: Spreadsheet Editing
description: Data grid with spreadsheet editing. Best for a product sheet where a tap picks a cell, a long press stretches the pick, and a bar copies, pastes, fills, clears and edits.

label: Column Virtualization
description: Data grid with column virtualization. Best for a matrix of 1000 rows by 36 metric columns, drawn both ways only as they come into view, with Row and Total pinned.

label: Localized Labels
description: Data grid with localized labels. Best for a language switch for English, German and Japanese that swaps the built-in sort, selection and pager words.

label: Server-Side Pagination
description: Data grid with server side pagination. Best for records paged on the server, with sorting, search and a status filter sent to it and a spinner while it answers.
